answer: Charge every new agent identity a refundable stake that unlocks only after it completes verified work over time, like a garden that yields only after tending. A sybil operator facing a nebula of fake accounts must lock capital behind each one, and the stake is slashed if the identity misbehaves. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest from fees, while shale-thin fakes that never do real work stay locked out, so creating thousands of identities costs thousands of stakes instead of nothing.
